adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/office365calendar/lib/CalendarService.ts`, the previous logic did `refreshTokenResponseSchema.safeParse(responseJson)` and, on failure, only `console.error(...)` while still proceeding to `await prisma.credential.update(...)` with the existing credentials (`...(tokenResponse.success && tokenResponse.data)` would contribute nothing). The new code calls `parseRefreshTokenResponse(responseJson, refreshTokenResponseSchema)`, and `parseRefreshTokenResponse` explicitly `throw new Error("Invalid refreshed tokens were returned")` when parsing fails. The console.error diagnostic block was also removed. This is a verified behavioral change from log-and-continue to throwing; whether that is a defect vs an intentional tightening isn't provable from the diff alone.
